title: Beyond Recognition: Evaluating Visual Perspective Taking in Vision Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to spatial reasoning questions (e.g., identifying which cardinal direction a minifigure is facing) across various visual modifications (removing contextual objects, changing zoom levels, adding on-image cardinal hints) and textual prompt permutations to detect an unwarranted preference for specific cardinal directions (e.g., East or South).
